name: 111 會考模擬二模（翰林 1～4 冊）英語聽力（附聽力稿）
source: 翰林 111 學年國中教育會考模擬測驗（範圍 1～4 冊），答案與解析取自官方試題分析

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
Peter is watching videos on his phone when taking a train to Taipei.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：Peter 在往臺北的火車上正在用手機看影片。（關鍵字：watching videos on his phone／train），故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
The dog is so cute. Amy is playing with it, but her brother is afraid of the dog.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：這隻小狗很可愛。Amy 正在和牠玩耍，但是她的弟弟卻很怕狗。（關鍵字：Amy is playing／brother is afraid），故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
There are a lot of yummy cookies on the table, but few people are eating them.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：桌上有很多好吃的餅乾，但很少人正在吃它們。（關鍵字：a lot of cookies／few people are eating），故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Dad, it’s raining heavily. Can you drive me to school today?
o: All right. Let’s wait for the bus.
No problem. My car needs cleaning.
questions.e: 中譯：爸，正在下大雨。你今天可以載我去學校嗎？→ 當然。先把你的早餐吃完。故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Excuse me, how can I get to the Taipei Bus Station?
o: The bus station is so big.
You can ask the police officer over there.
questions.e: 中譯：不好意思，我要怎麼去臺北公車總站？→ 你可以問那邊的警察。故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Oh, my! The ground is shaking!
o: An earthquake! Hide under the table!
You can go back to sleep.
questions.e: 中譯：我的天啊！地面正在搖晃！→ 地震！躲到桌子底下！故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How often do you visit your grandparents in the country?
questions.e: 中譯：你多久探望鄉下的祖父母呢？→ 每兩週一次。How often 問頻率，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
The blue jacket looks great on you. Where did you buy it?
o: It cost me only one hundred dollars.
The jacket is very bright and cool.
It is a birthday present from my dad.
questions.e: 中譯：你身上的這件藍色夾克看起來很棒。你在哪兒買的呢？→ 這是我爸送的生日禮物。故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Amy looked at Ben so angrily just now. What happened?
o: Ben helped Amy with her homework.
Ben planned to celebrate Amy’s birthday.
questions.e: 中譯：Amy 剛剛很生氣地看著 Ben。發生了什麼事？→ Ben 打破了 Amy 最喜歡的杯子。故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Paul and I are going to the movies this evening. Will you join us?
o: Why not? I’m glad to go with you.
Of course. I have a meeting then.
questions.e: 中譯：Paul 和我今晚要去看電影。你要加入我們嗎？→ 何不呢？我很樂意和你們一起去。故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
What’s that smell from the kitchen? It smells great.
o: Mia is baking a banana cake.
Mom is washing the dishes there.
questions.e: 中譯：廚房裡傳來的是什麼味道呢？聞起來好香。→ Mia 正在烤香蕉蛋糕。故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（廣播音樂）M: Good morning, everyone. This morning, something terrible happened in front of our school. A car ran away after it hit a student. The student was badly hurt, and he is in hospital now. The student was using his cellphone when walking across the road. That is very dangerous. Please be careful and watch out for the cars on the road. Don’t let your cellphone take away your life.
Q: Which picture shows what happened this morning?
questions.e: 由文意「我們學校門前發生了一件可怕的事…當這位學生在過馬路的時候，他正在使用手機…」，可推知選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
G: You and Ms. Brown know each other? What a surprise!
B: Ha! Ms. Brown is one of my mom’s best friends. She often visits my mom and has dinner with us on the weekend.
G: I see! Ms. Brown is an English teacher at my school. She teaches well, and all the students like her English class.
B: She is really a nice person. She always helps me with my English homework. You are lucky to have a teacher like her.
Q: What do we know about Ms. Brown?
o: She knows the girl’s mom very well.
She is the boy’s English teacher.
questions.e: 由對話可知她是女孩的英文老師、男孩媽媽的好友，而且學生都喜歡上她的課，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Take a look at this picture. What do you think about this one?
M: The living room is big. However, there are only two rooms.
W: You’re right. I’ll also need a garden to plant flowers.
M: Look! The one next to it looks great.
W: I don’t think so. The kitchen is too small. Besides, we’ll need two bathrooms.
M: I couldn’t agree with you more. I don’t want to wait when I need to use the bathroom in the early morning.
Q: What do they want to buy?
questions.e: 對話中提到客廳、房間、花園、廚房、浴室等，因此可推論他們要買房子，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: What are you looking for?
W: I am looking for my chopsticks and spoon.
M: You don’t need to. There are chopsticks and spoons on the table. Just use them.
W: No. These will become trash. We have made too much trash in our life, and I don’t want to make more.
M: All right, but even though you don’t use them, others will.
W: I know. Saving the earth is not a habit to many people, so I always try to have people around me do the same. This way, there will be less and less trash.
Q: What’s important for the woman?
o: To help cut down the trash.
To ask others to eat healthy food.
questions.e: 對話中女子很在乎不製造多餘的餐具垃圾，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Hi. Check out, please.
W: No problem. Is that all?
M: Yes, please.
W: OK, wait a minute. The total is NT$290. By the way, when you spend NT$50, you can get a point. Do you want to buy something more to get 6 points?
M: Why not? Let me see. I can buy the candy. It only costs NT$15.
W: Great! Here are your six points. Thank you and have a nice day.
Q: How much did the man pay in total?
questions.e: 男子原本買了共新臺幣 290 元的東西，為了湊點數又多買了新臺幣 15 元的糖果，所以總共花費了新臺幣 305 元，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（下課鐘聲）B: Tim asked you out last Saturday. Why didn’t you go out with him?
G: Well, he is not my type.
B: Come on! He is tall and handsome. He is also a great basketball player. Almost every girl at the school is crazy about him.
G: Well, I know he is very popular. However, he often goes to school late and sleeps in class. I don’t think he is a good student.
B: Oh, I see. You are a good student, and you want to make friends with students just like you.
G: That’s right!
Q: What does the girl mean by saying “he is not my type”?
questions.e: 女孩在對話中透露出不喜歡 Tim 的原因（常遲到、上課睡覺），「not my type」即「不是我喜歡的類型」，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（車輛經過的聲音）M: You look beautiful in this pink dress. It really goes well with your hair.
W: Thanks. I bought it at Nina’s Shop. It just opened last week.
M: My wife’s birthday is coming. Maybe I should go there and buy a dress as her birthday gift.
W: You are really a good husband. By the way, if you say something good about them on their Facebook, you can get a small gift from them.
M: That’s great. Could you tell me where Nina’s Shop is?
W: OK, let me check it on my cellphone. Wait a minute.
Q: What is the woman going to do next?
o: Make a phone call to Nina.
Buy a dress for the man’s wife.
questions.e: 由末句「讓我查看一下手機。請稍等。」可推知女子接下來會拿出手機查詢地址，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（下雨聲）M: Hey! What happened to you, Erica? Why are you all wet?
W: It was raining hard on my way to the office.
M: Didn’t you bring an umbrella? It started raining early this morning.
W: I did. But someone took it away when I was having my breakfast at the burger house. I put it outside the shop. When I was going to leave, I found it was gone.
M: Poor you!
W: （嘆息聲）Getting wet is not a big deal to me. But I really hope I can get my umbrella back. I bought that umbrella in Japan. It is my favorite.
M: Maybe you can ask the owner of the burger house. Hope you can get it back!
Q: Where did Erica lose her umbrella?
questions.e: 按照對話敘述，Erica 是在漢堡屋吃早餐時把傘放在店外，離開時發現傘不見了，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: Your teacher, Mr. Smith, called me last night.
B: What did he say?
W: He told me you copied Alice’s answers on the math test. Why did you do that?
B: I am sorry, Mom. Math is really difficult to me. I didn’t understand the questions on the test. I won’t do that again. Can I have one more chance?
W: Fine, but you have to study hard to prepare for the math test next time.
B: All right, Mom.
Q: Why was the boy’s mom unhappy?
o: Her son cheated on the test.
questions.e: 由對話得知男孩媽媽被老師告知兒子在數學考試抄襲 Alice 的答案（作弊），故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（廣播聲音）M: Good morning, everyone! Welcome to Paula’s Flower Garden, one of the most beautiful gardens in this city. Paula Parker built this garden three years ago. In this flower garden, you can get to know many kinds of flowers. If you want to learn more about these flowers, I can also share some knowledge with you. We also have special flower tea. You can try it at some shops in the garden. There are also delicious meals with flowers in them. They are yummy and smell great. You won’t want to miss them! Now, let me show you around the garden. Please feel free to take pictures here. Enjoy your time! Hope you all have a wonderful day!
Q: What can we know about Paula’s Flower Garden?
o: You can eat special food with flowers there.
Paula Parker shows people around the garden.
questions.e: (A) Paula 花園三年前才建成，不可能有悠久的歷史。(B)廣播文有提到有花入菜的餐點。(C) Paula Parker 是蓋花園的人，不是帶大家逛花園的人。故選(B)。
